description: Report account login, sync service health and the person's next step for one label or every label. Reads local state only, needs no network or daemon, and never writes anything. Other people's text never appears here; no message content, phone numbers, account ids or keys are returned.

account.description: The account label; absent lists every label.

name: telegram_account_read

accounts.description: Accounts sorted by label; no phone numbers, account ids or keys.

action.description: The person's next step, or null when none is needed.

chats.description: The number of chats in the mirror, or null when there is no mirror.

connected_at.description: When the service last connected to Telegram, in local time with offset.

error.description: The recorded service error or mirror-version refusal, without message content or account identifiers.

followed.description: The number of followed chats in the mirror, or null when there is no mirror.

hint.description: One sentence explaining the person's next step, or null.

label.description: The label used to select this account.

last_received_at.description: When a message was last received, in local time with offset.

login.description: Whether this account is logged in.

messages.description: The number of messages in the mirror, or null when there is no mirror.

refreshed_at.description: When the chat list was last refreshed, in local time with offset.

service.description: The recorded sync service state, corrected for a service process that is no longer alive.

title: Read account status
